crossRefs.note: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

people.name: Azarel
people.line: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jeroham
people.line: A leader from the tribe of Dan.
